title.fa: «خود» پوستهٔ «نهاد»: دو قانون در یک دستگاه
title.en: The ego as the bark of the id: two laws in one apparatus
title.nl: The ego as the bark of the id: two laws in one apparatus

summary.fa: فروید برای توضیح رابطهٔ «خود» و «نهاد» دو تصویر می‌سازد: پوستهٔ تنهٔ درخت، و خط اصلی جبهه در برابر پشت جبهه. از هر دو یک نکته بیرون می‌آید: آن‌چه «خود» را متفاوت می‌کند نزدیکی‌اش به دنیای خارج است، و همین نزدیکی قانون کارش را عوض می‌کند.
summary.en: To explain the relation of ego and id Freud builds two images: the bark of a tree trunk, and the front line against the rear. Both yield one point: what makes the ego different is its nearness to the external world, and that nearness changes the law it works by.
summary.nl: To explain the relation of ego and id Freud builds two images: the bark of a tree trunk, and the front line against the rear. Both yield one point: what makes the ego different is its nearness to the external world, and that nearness changes the law it works by.

text.fa: تصویر اول: «"خود" را به‌منزلهٔ سردری بر یک بنا فرض کنید که آن بنا "نهاد" است. به زبان ساده‌تر "خود" را می‌توان پوستهٔ خارجی "نهاد" فرض کرد.»
text.en: The first image: "take the ego as the façade of a building whose building is the id. More simply, the ego may be taken as the outer rind of the id."
text.nl: The first image: "take the ego as the façade of a building whose building is the id. More simply, the ego may be taken as the outer rind of the id."

text.fa: و بسطش با درخت: پوسته‌های تنهٔ درخت، یعنی قسمت‌هایی که در خارج واقع شده‌اند، «در عین حال که مشخصات به‌خصوص خود را دارند، تحت تأثیر عوامل و محیط خارج که با آن در تماس هستند نیز واقع می‌شوند» — و «خود» همان قشری است که بر اثر نفوذ دنیای خارج تغییر می‌کند و تعدیل می‌شود.
text.en: Its elaboration with the tree: the bark of a trunk, the part lying outside, "while having characteristics of its own, is also subject to the external agencies and environment it touches" — and the ego is that layer which is altered and modified by the influence of the external world.
text.nl: Its elaboration with the tree: the bark of a trunk, the part lying outside, "while having characteristics of its own, is also subject to the external agencies and environment it touches" — and the ego is that layer which is altered and modified by the influence of the external world.

text.fa: نتیجهٔ جایگاهی: «هنگامی که از خارج نظر اندازیم "خود" در حقیقت پوسته‌ای است، در صورتی که "نهاد" چیزی است عمیق‌تر و وسیع‌تر»؛ و «خود» میان واقعیت زندگی و «نهاد» جای دارد.
text.en: The positional conclusion: "looked at from outside, the ego is in truth a rind, whereas the id is something deeper and wider"; and the ego lies between the reality of life and the id.
text.nl: The positional conclusion: "looked at from outside, the ego is in truth a rind, whereas the id is something deeper and wider"; and the ego lies between the reality of life and the id.

text.fa: تصویر دوم، از جنگ جهانی اول: «انجام بسیاری از کارها در پشت جبهه مجاز بود در حالی که انجام همان کارها در خط اصلی جبهه ممنوع شده بود. آشکار است که علت اساسی این منع در خط اصلی جبهه، نزدیکی دشمن به آن‌جا بود.»
text.en: The second image, from the First World War: "many things were permitted behind the lines which were forbidden at the front. The basic reason for the prohibition at the front was plainly the nearness of the enemy."
text.nl: The second image, from the First World War: "many things were permitted behind the lines which were forbidden at the front. The basic reason for the prohibition at the front was plainly the nearness of the enemy."

text.fa: و کاربردش: «در زندگی روحی نیز علت منع پاره‌ای کارها نزدیکی و تماس دنیای خارج — که مانند دشمن و بیگانه به شمار می‌آید — به "خود" است؛ و در این‌جا "خود" را می‌توان خط اصلی جبهه حساب آورد.»
text.en: And its application: "in mental life too, the reason some things are forbidden is the nearness and contact of the external world — which counts as enemy and stranger — to the ego; and here the ego may be reckoned the front line."
text.nl: And its application: "in mental life too, the reason some things are forbidden is the nearness and contact of the external world — which counts as enemy and stranger — to the ego; and here the ego may be reckoned the front line."

text.fa: تفاوت قانون: «در "نهاد" جنگ و جدالی وجود ندارد. تناقضات و تضادها در کنار هم قرار دارند و غالباً به‌وسیلهٔ ایجاد سازش، اختلافات حل و تسویه می‌شوند. اما در "خود" چنین نیست.» «خود» کشمکش را حس می‌کند و باید تصمیم قطعی بگیرد، و آن تصمیم به این صورت گرفته می‌شود که «یک انگیزه فدای انگیزهٔ دیگر می‌گردد».
text.en: The difference in law: "in the id there is no war or strife. Contradictions and oppositions lie side by side, and differences are usually settled by compromise. In the ego it is not so." The ego feels the conflict and must decide, and the decision is made such that "one impulse is sacrificed to another."
text.nl: The difference in law: "in the id there is no war or strife. Contradictions and oppositions lie side by side, and differences are usually settled by compromise. In the ego it is not so." The ego feels the conflict and must decide, and the decision is made such that "one impulse is sacrificed to another."

text.fa: و تفاوت دوم: «صفت بارز و مشخص دستگاه "خود" تمایل قابل‌ملاحظهٔ آن به‌سوی اتحاد و ترکیب است، در حالی که "نهاد" چنین خاصیتی ندارد»؛ گویی نهاد از اجزای مختلف ساخته شده و انگیزه‌هایش هر یک آزادانه و مستقل و بدون اعتنا به دیگری هدف خود را دنبال می‌کنند.
text.en: And a second difference: "the striking and distinctive property of the ego is its marked tendency toward unification and synthesis, while the id has no such property"; the id is as if built of separate parts, each impulse pursuing its aim freely, independently, and without regard to the others.
text.nl: And a second difference: "the striking and distinctive property of the ego is its marked tendency toward unification and synthesis, while the id has no such property"; the id is as if built of separate parts, each impulse pursuing its aim freely, independently, and without regard to the others.

text.fa: فروید خودش این‌ها را فرضیه می‌خواند، نه مشاهده: پیش از آن می‌گوید این تئوری «مانند یک مکتب فلسفی تنظیم نگشته است. ما آن را به آهستگی و به‌تدریج کامل کردیم… پیوسته آن را تغییر دادیم و اصلاح کردیم»، و تضمین نمی‌کند شکلش قطعی باشد.
text.en: Freud himself calls these hypotheses rather than observations: he says beforehand that this theory "was not drawn up like a school of philosophy. We completed it slowly and gradually… continually changing and correcting it," and he does not guarantee its form is final.
